target.note: half of each by-gas ceiling: the gas target of the fee rule (30,000,000 gas per block), computed

dappGasLimitRun.note: Added after the independent check of section 11 (section 11.3.1 of the report). The ordering step with privacy, makeOrder sent with the gas limit the customer dApp sends (the local node's estimate x 1.25) through the switch MAKEORDER_GAS_LIMIT of benchmark-concurrent.cjs. The limit is a fixed number for the run; the dApp was not run and no estimate was asked per order. One run, not repeated here; the check's scratch run R2 (256 clients x 3 orders after a 128-client level) gave the same makeOrder count in every block.
